subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw main own a committed Microsoft ecosystem tracker and PR-body updater, or should this stay as maintainer-side tracking outside the source tree?
rationale: The remaining choice is not purely mechanical: the branch adds an ongoing admin workflow and generated repository artifact, and the protected `maintainer` label requires owner intent before closing, hardening, or merging it.

options.title: Harden Before Merge
options.body: Accept the repo-owned tracker direction only after the generator is sanitized, checkable, proof-backed, and stripped of the normal PR changelog edit.

options.title: Keep Tracking Outside Main
options.body: Continue using the draft PR body, GitHub search, or project tooling for Microsoft triage without adding generated tracker files to the source tree.

options.title: Stop This Tracker
options.body: Close the tracker effort if maintainers no longer want a Microsoft-specific rollup after the issue purge.

recommendation.title: Harden Before Merge
recommendation.body: Accept the repo-owned tracker direction only after the generator is sanitized, checkable, proof-backed, and stripped of the normal PR changelog edit.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level admin/product workflow choice, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` identifies Peter Steinberger as the top maintainer.
